content_sections.heading: SGMH Senior Resident Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The vacancy count is provisional and may increase or decrease. Four percent of the total posts are reserved for Persons with Disabilities according to the applicable rules.

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the following educational and registration requirements: MBBS degree from a recognized university or institution. Postgraduate Degree, Diploma or DNB in the concerned specialty. Valid registration with the Delhi Medical Council. Candidates who have applied for Delhi Medical Council registration must produce proof of application at the walk-in interview. The candidate must not have completed three years of Senior Residency in any recognized institution on a regular or ad-hoc basis.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility for Non-PG Candidates
content_sections.text: In specialties with a continuous shortage of eligible candidates, such as Radiology, Anaesthesia and Forensic Medicine, candidates with two years of experience in the concerned specialty may be allowed to attend the interview even without a postgraduate qualification. Non-PG candidates can be selected only on an ad-hoc basis and will be considered when suitable postgraduate candidates are unavailable.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility for Candidates Who Completed Three Years of Senior Residency
content_sections.text: In shortage specialties or when fresh candidates are unavailable, candidates who have already completed three years of Senior Residency may also be considered. A separate merit list will be prepared for fresh candidates and candidates who have completed three years of Senior Residency. Fresh candidates will be considered first. The second merit list will be used only after the fresh-candidate list is exhausted. Appointments from the second list will be for one year only and will not be renewable.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age will be calculated as of the interview date, 24 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: Salary
content_sections.text: Selected Senior Residents will receive salary under Pay Matrix Level 11 of the 7th Central Pay Commission.

rows.rs_67_700_to_rs_2_08_700: Applicable allowances according to government rules

content_sections.heading: Appointment Period
content_sections.text: The initial appointment will be for 89 days or until a regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier. The appointment may be extended, subject to satisfactory work performance, conduct report from the concerned Head of Department and a written request from the doctor. The total Senior Residency period, including previous Senior Residency experience, cannot exceed three years.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The official interview notice does not mention an application fee.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a walk-in interview only . Registration at the interview venue Verification of original documents Walk-in interview Preparation of the merit list Medical and appointment formalities for selected candidates If interviews for all registered candidates cannot be completed on the scheduled date, they may continue on the following working day or on another date announced by the hospital.

content_sections.heading: Walk-in Interview Details
content_sections.text: Candidates must report before 12:00 noon. Entry will not be permitted after the registration closing time.

rows.24_september_2026: 4th Floor Conference Hall, Administrative Block, Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital, Mangolpuri, Delhi - 110083

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Download or prepare the application in the format attached to the official notice. Fill in all required personal, educational, registration and experience details. Attach a recent passport-size photograph. Attach self-attested copies of the required certificates. Prepare the document checklist in the order mentioned in the notification. Attend the walk-in interview at Sanjay Gandhi Memorial Hospital on 24 September 2026. Complete registration between 9:00 AM and 12:00 noon. Bring the completed application, original documents and photocopies for verification. Incomplete applications will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Completed application form Date-of-birth certificate or Class 10 certificate/mark sheet Valid caste or category certificate, where applicable MBBS mark sheets and degree certificate Internship completion certificate Delhi Medical Council registration certificate Postgraduate Degree, Diploma or DNB mark sheets and certificate Attempt certificate Aadhaar card Experience certificates, where applicable No Objection Certificate for candidates already employed in government service Two recent passport-size photographs Candidates must bring all applicable documents in original along with self-attested photocopies.

content_sections.heading: Category Certificate Requirements
content_sections.text: Only OBC certificates issued by the Government of NCT of Delhi will be accepted. OBC candidates must possess a valid Non-Creamy Layer certificate for the current financial year. EWS candidates must possess a valid EWS certificate for the current financial year. If suitable reserved-category candidates are unavailable, vacancies may be filled temporarily from another category on an ad-hoc basis.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must report at the venue between 9:00 AM and 12:00 noon. No candidate will be allowed to register after 12:00 noon. Candidates already in government service must produce an NOC from their employer. No TA or DA will be paid for attending the interview. Hostel accommodation is subject to availability and is not mandatory. Selected candidates must join within seven working days from the issue of the offer letter. The number of vacancies may change without prior notice. Selected candidates cannot work in another government or private healthcare facility during their tenure at SGMH. The interview result will be displayed on the Delhi Health Department website, the SGMH website and the hospital notice board.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in SGMH Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 52 Senior Resident vacancies across 13 medical departments.

faq.question: Q2. When will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 24 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the reporting time?
faq.answer: Candidates must register between 9:00 AM and 12:00 noon. Entry will not be allowed after 12:00 noon.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for SGMH Senior Residents?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs.67,700 to Rs.2,08,700 under Pay Level 11, plus applicable allowances.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years for General candidates. Age relaxation is available for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess an MBBS degree and a postgraduate Degree, Diploma or DNB in the concerned specialty, along with Delhi Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q7. Can non-PG candidates attend the interview?
faq.answer: Non-PG candidates with two years of relevant experience may be considered in shortage specialties when suitable postgraduate candidates are unavailable.
